seo.title: Affiliate Program
seo.description: Join the Your Company affiliate program: promote our treks and tours through your website, social media or travel business and earn a commission on every booking.

intro.title: Affiliate Program
intro.body:
Your Company is a premier travel, trekking and tour company located in Kathmandu that is highly regarded by our satisfied clients for our exceptional tours of the Himalayas. Our team is dedicated to providing top-notch service and a genuine love for exploring the majestic beauty of the region.

An affiliate program at Your Company is a marketing strategy where we partner with individuals or businesses to promote our products or services. The affiliate marketers earn a commission for each successful booking or sale made through the referral link or code.

Affiliates can promote travel products and services through various methods such as websites, social media, email marketing, and blog posts.

Who can Affiliate with Your Company?

Any person, organisation or travel company can affiliate with Your Company. If you are a travel agent, an individual who uses social media, a travel blogger or an influencer, Your Company is a great platform for you to make regular passive income through our affiliate program.

How to affiliate with Your Company?

There are a few steps and some terms and conditions to affiliate with us. Please fill in the form below and get in touch with us. We then make further communication and finalise it.
